name: h1r_edge_s5_rope4d
title: Biohub H1R Edge S5 RoPE4D
purpose: S5 adjacent-frame Zh001r association training with H1R_EDGE_POS_ENCODING=rope4d: the association transformer's attention queries/keys receive a parameter-free rotary factor over (t, z, y, x) in physical units (z 1.625 um, y/x 0.40625 um per full-res voxel, 1 frame in t; K=4 geometric bands per axis from 200 um / 20 frames down to 10 um / 2 frames). The rotary factor is relative-displacement based; the retained absolute sinusoidal inputs mean the complete model is not translation-equivariant (scripts/kaggle_edits/h1r_rope4d.py). The same OOF split_0 initialisation as h1r_edge_s5.json loads strictly, the detector is frozen byte-for-byte, and config.json declares the rotation so the LOEO consumer re-installs it at inference. Gate 2: held-out Zh001r link_top1 / candidate_recall vs the sinusoidal S5 run at equal steps (FACT-0329 baseline); rope4d is dead if it does not beat sinusoidal on link_top1. No submission.

deploy_consumers.byproduct_reason: auxiliary triplet appearance head trained alongside the edge model; no inference path in the P3/P9 lineage consumes it, and the LOEO transfer gate scores the edge weights alone
